name: io.github.DACS-Agent-commerce/demos-mcp
title: DACS Listings (testnet)
description: Finds and checks DACS seller Listings, read-only; testnet writes are refused in this release.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: https URL of the Demos testnet RPC node to read from. There is no built-in node.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Network to use. Leave unset for testnet.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where the server keeps its local state. Defaults to ~/.demos-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the write tools. Not for a testnet RPC in this release: testnet writes are refused.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_WALLET_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to purchase-only to stop the older tools from opening the wallet or signing.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_DAILY_CAP_DEM
environmentVariables.description: Daily spending cap in DEM for approved actions.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated addresses that payments may go to. Unset means no allow-list.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_KEYSTORE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the encrypted wallet keystore file.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_KEYSTORE_PASSPHRASE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the keystore passphrase.

environmentVariables.name: DEMOS_MNEMONIC_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a plaintext file holding the wallet mnemonic (chmod 600). Discouraged; use a keystore.
